The real question is never “why am I so wrong?” — it’s “how do I improve on yesterday’s version of myself?” Take the lesson, bank it, and move on. Dragging today’s frustration into tomorrow’s session just hands the market free money.  Psychology is everything. Come back tomorrow clear-headed and ready. The setups will come again. ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Psychology is everything. Come back tomorrow clear-headed and ready. The setups will come again. ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
apr 21 Notes:


I took a winning trade of about 500 today and it should have been 1000 but due to me messing up a lot at the end of the trade I got stopped in profit. Definitely deserved and lesson will be learned.
,
Today what I was thinking was pretty obvious, we had asian and london lows all stacked up and I wanted to see them get taken at market open and trade into the discount of the range. That is exactly what happened and we got an external and internal smt and then we made a 5min cisd, but I didn’t enter right off of that, I waited for bullish close out of it and then entered off of a 1 minute gap. (Screenshot 1-3)
,
My initial take profit can be seen in screenshot 2 and that would have hit, but then the trade was going so well and I thought it would go to all time highs, but we got an smt at the high of my initial tp and at that point I definitely should have taken profit, but I think it is safe to say I got a little greedy. I got stopped at the 10:00 swing low which I thought would be the only manipulation for the 4h candle, but we went further.
,
The short off of the 5min rb that stopped me out actually would have been a good trade too, we have an smt, entry trigger and el. The only thing that would have made me fad it most likely is there isn’t really a clear enough bearish dol to make me short at all time highs. (Screenshot 4)
,
Another potential trade that I saw was the 1h wick at the bottom of the range gave perfect delivery with a 1min rb. If I was trading pm session today, this is definitely a trade that I would consider and most likely take. (Screenshot 5 & 6)
,
The lesson from today is that I should just trust my initial judgement and don’t adjust a trade that is in progress or exit a trade in progress. My best judgement is going to come before a big green or red number is being displayed on my screen so trust that.
,

messages.author: NS Picklo
messages.content_text:
tuesday - 21st april day 4  
loss : -60 
bias - bullish , at ath so bullish usually most probable but first i was expecting the 1hr lows to the left then higher from around 0.5 of the range , the lows got taken pretty much straight away at market open so i was waiting for longs 

trade 1 : looking for 9:30 high to be taken after hitting discount of range 9:30 opened and manipulated lower , 4hr ob , 1hr breaker , 0.5 of htf range (enged) were hit and made a 1min rb and i entered when price started rejecting from the rb targetting the high but i market entered and had to use positions tools to set sl and tp then i accidentally closed position and a stop limit was hit so i closed that straight away and i was down -20 but i wouldve been stopped anyway . 
trade 2 (re-entry) : i decided to re enter once the low was swept and 1min smt was made , when a 1min rb was made i waited for a bullish candle close and entered when price came back into the wick and started rejecting had 10pt sl and targeted same high , i was more confident this time as 0.5 was actually hit and there was smt eventhough it was just on 1 min but i ended up getting scared when i saw price come lower as i was about to set sl so i exited early (i wouldnt have even been stopped out if i had a sl and hit tp) . i decided not to trade again after this but saw that later on a 1hr rb i had in mind worked out alright

messages.content_text:
Date: April 21, 2026


Market Observation
,
• Did my setup appear? (Yes / No) Yes
• If yes, why didn’t I take it? (rules / emotional / missed / observation day) My trading window closed so i cancelled my limit.
Was skipping the trade the correct decision? (Yes / No)
Why? Yes because we started chopping 10am open so i cancelled my trade.


Discipline Check
,
• Did I follow my rules by not trading? (Yes / No) Yes


Market Notes
,
• What did I notice about price action today? I noticed that price was a little slow and slightly choppy by the end of my trading window.
• Did anything confirm or challenge my bias? We had a 1 hr smt at london highs.


Reflection
,
• How did it feel to not trade today? It felt fine to me i remained calm and relaxed.
• One thing I learned from observing: I learned that sometimes i’m not gonna get the entry and that’s okay with me.

Would I repeat this exact day again? yes

What WOULD I have done if today was tradable? Probably derisked since the conditions were B tier.

Reminder:
“Patience is part of my edge. Protecting capital is a winning day.”

messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
apr 20 Notes:


Today I did not take a trade mostly because it was a no news monday, but the one confluence I was looking at would have won.
,
We made a big nwog down this week and traded into it during overnight so I thought during new york we would trade to the top of nwog. 10:00 opened and traded lower with no trading above so I thought we would see a 10:00 setup. Price kept trading down though to the bottom of the nwog and rejected off of a 4h wick while making an smt with overnight session lows. We traded up strong and I was waiting for a move back to discount which aligned with a 5min cisd and 30m rb which was the level I was looking at. I would have targeted 10:00 which got hit after 4:00 and I would most likely hold until then and this trade would be a 1:7rr. (Screenshots 1-3)
,
I’m not upset I missed this trade because it is a no news monday, but say I saw something like this tomorrow for example, I should definitely take the trade. I think I should consider 5min confluences as entry triggers and not just as pd arrays because I could have entered off of this one successfully.
,

messages.content_text:
monday - 20th april day 3  
win : +1000
bias -bullish , at ath now and this week opened lower into a htf fvg + ote of htf range so i expected to see bullish from there but i was thinking i wanted to see price come back below 18:00 then react to the rb although that did end up happening i just caught a trade around market open 
trade 1: when market opened price swept the high first which was not ideal but then manipulated lower into a 5min rb and made an smt + 1min rb off 0.795 of range so i set a limit just above ce with sl at the low for 10pt and tp at 50pt because thats what i needed to pass eval and thought the high would be taken but it wasnt . i trailed to break even when the 1min gap was hit as i did see some reason for price to short so i wanted to be safe , im just really looking for longs because weve taken ath

messages.author: Komu
messages.content_text:
Alright finally back after a week break and honestly I really needed that, tried my hardest to just be outside everyday go on some hikes with my boys and yeah,

I think I found out what was causing my over trading and it was just, 

rushing the process because i feel as though i need to retire my parents right now which just had the opposite effect 

Being scared to lose, id close trades early then see it hit tp and then revenge trade

fomo, id call out a trade in my head then dont take it and then it turns out to be a winner which causes me to just again over trade

and finally was my leverage, I wanted quick big wins with 1 mini but the losses are just way to much which causes me to leverage even higher to win back the losses.
